message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The trajectory was generally careful: the doctor repeatedly reconciled medications, used records and family read-backs, tracked staged Holter/lab results, and built an executable handoff to cardiology and psychiatric-medication review. However, the authored acute-risk duty required screening self-harm/harm-to-others risk; the observable safety-net repeatedly covered cardiopulmonary red flags but never explicitly screened or handled self/other-harm risk. Under the frozen rubric, that minor responsibility-chain omission caps the grade at 2 despite multiple high-order
